cohort: 52 women who underwent cesarean hysterectomy (cases) and 52 women who underwent cesarean section alone (controls)
finding: There was no significant difference in depression or sexual function between women who underwent hysterectomy and those who did not 3-6 months after surgery.
mod_finding: This study focused on depression and sexual function after hysterectomy and cesarean section and did not compare outcomes by mode of delivery.
